nodes.title: Nazariya law as one height-map block plot under five Khand modes (views, array, floor, powers, mirror): generators, solvers, shortcut search, kit mal-rules, board twin; src/play/families/nazariya (r4-khand, 2026-10-10)

Khand builds are height maps (a block rests on the ground or a block; a side-face tap drops onto that column). Every claimed topic is a height-map task and the law, views and fence stay exact. Reversal: a claimed topic needs overhangs or holes (e.g. nets, hollow solids) — then the law moves to a voxel set and the projections to per-cell ray tests

Nazariya truth battery: 0 wrong grades over >= 5,000 acts per mode (5 modes, ~25,000 acts; random + mal-rule + solver acts) against an independent oracle; generator p95 <= 12 ms single process; tampered plots, claim fields and cross-level replays refused (tests/r4-khand-law.test.mjs, node, 2026-10-10)
Greedy mesher with corner AO covers exactly the naive faces on 300 random builds; quads naive→greedy: 4x4x4 cube 80→9, 6x4 floor 44→5, 9x9 pit 165→9 (tests/r4-khand-mesher.test.mjs, node, 2026-10-10)

Khand meshes in a Web Worker (buffers transferred, pooled GPU buffers, latest request wins) with the same pure mesher on the main thread only when no worker can start. Reversal: a device where the worker round trip exceeds one frame of a main-thread mesh for lesson-sized plots

Khand claims 11 class 4-6 maths topics (views c4-ch02-t01; arrays c4-ch09-t01; area/perimeter c5-ch11-t01/t02/t03, c6-ch06-t01/t02; square and cube numbers c6-ch01-t01; mirror c4-ch11-t02, c5-ch10-t02, c6-ch09-t01) over 15 rules, every mal-rule mapped to a verified kit misconception. Reversal: a topic's certificate fails on the integrated tree

Khand block textures and sky are drawn in code (a 64x64 pixel atlas, a gradient dome, voxel hills and trees), not Azure-generated images: zero bytes, no text to review, deterministic. Reversal: the owner calls the look basic; then generate text-free skyboxes with DEPLOY_IMAGE (WebP < 300 KB, reviewed)

A child's Khand build is saved (play_build, migration number placeholder 024) only from the server's own replay of a solved level; heights only, no counter; GET /api/play/builds lists them. Reversal: the owner wants unsolved free builds kept too
Port Khand from its thin three.js adapter (src/play/engines/khand + patch 04 engine mount) onto G1's CORE-API once main merges G1
Khand frame rate and touch are measured only on headless SwiftShader at 4x CPU throttle; a real ₹10k phone run is owner-dependent (O-R4)

Khand fps at 4x CPU throttle, SwiftShader proxy, DPR 1, camera orbiting: 54-55 at 360x800, 40-47 at 412x915, 16-18 at 1366x768; our JS 1-4 ms p50 per frame, 5-11 draws, <10k triangles (n = 9 runs x 10 s, headless Chromium, load 1.2-4.6, 2026-10-10)
Khand re-mesh in the worker: 0.1-0.2 ms p50 / 0.2-2.0 ms p95 per edit, 0 ms on the main thread (prototype main-thread re-mesh 8.2 / 19.1 ms) (n = 40 edits x 9 runs, 4x throttle, proxy, 2026-10-10)
Khand C4 floor audit: 104 shots (13 mode/goals x 3 viewports, engine and 2D twin, mistake/solved at 360), 0 failures; lesson Desk 9/9 views pass (headless, 2026-10-10)

Khand C9 loop on a local production build: 139/139 checks; every entry served, graded and tamper-refused; builds saved; one kt_evidence row via game, replays fold nothing; 'game khelna hai' puts the block world on stage (n = 1 run, 3 asks, own Neon TEST branch, 2026-10-10)

Floor facts row floor=9 fence=12 sides=3x3: the seam turn said 'perimeter 9' for a 3x3 floor (n = 1, model output, C9 run 2026-10-10). Replaced by area / perimeter / rect '3 by 3'; the re-run read it right
C10 unmet on the proxy at 412 (40-47 fps) and 1366 (16-18): SwiftShader fill-bound at the tier-3d DPR floor 1.0; needs the phone run (O-R4) or a lower floor (G1 / owner)

C9 'at a practice beat' unmet for Khand topics: 0/3 practice lessons (4, 4, 9 typed turns) offered the game unasked; the offer rule is the Director's / compose ladder's (tests/prod/r4-khand-beat.mjs, local prod, 2026-10-10)
